basic.name: Withering Fire
basic.description: Shoot the closest enemy up to 5 times over 1.5 seconds for 39~~0.04~~ damage, prioritizing Heroes. Cooldown is reset on getting a Takedown.

basic.name: Shadow Dagger
basic.description: Throw a dagger at a target enemy that deals 30~~0.04~~ damage and an additional 150~~0.04~~ damage over 2.5 seconds. Damage dealt by Sylvanas to the initial target spreads Shadow Dagger to all nearby enemies.

basic.name: Haunting Wave
basic.description: Send forth a wave of banshees dealing 114~~0.04~~ damage to all targets. Reactivate to teleport to the banshees' location.

basic.name: Haunting Teleport
basic.description: Activate to teleport to the banshees' location.

heroic.name: Wailing Arrow
heroic.description: Shoot an arrow that can be reactivated to deal 228~~0.04~~ damage and Silence enemies in an area for 2.5 seconds. The arrow detonates automatically if it reaches maximum range.

heroic.name: Mind Control
heroic.description: After 0.25 seconds, fire a missile that Mind Controls the first enemy Hero hit. Heroes hit are Silenced, Slowed by 30%, have 3 stacks of Black Arrows applied to them, and are forced to walk towards Sylvanas for 1.75 seconds.

trait.name: Black Arrows
trait.description:
Basic Attacks infect enemies with Black Arrows for 3 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. Sylvanas deals 15% more damage to enemies with 3 stacks.

Quest: Damage Heroes and Structures with 3 stacks of Black Arrows.

Reward: Upon damaging enemies 250 times, increase the damage bonus provided by Black Arrows to 50%.

Mythic Reward: Upon damaging enemies 400 times, Black Arrows now heals Sylvanas for 25% of damage dealt at 3 stacks, doubled against Heroes.

activable.name: Possession
activable.description: Activate to force an enemy Minion to fight for Sylvanas's team. Catapults require 3 charges. Stores up to 4 charges.

activable.name: Will of the Forsaken
activable.description: Activate to become Unstoppable and gain 40% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

activable.name: Bolt of the Storm
activable.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.

level1.name: Might of the Banshee Queen
level1.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Withering Fire increases Sylvanas's Attack Speed and Spell Power by 5% for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

level1.name: Unrelenting Torment
level1.description: Increase the damage of Shadow Dagger by 20% and increase its duration by 1 second.

level1.name: Overwhelming Affliction
level1.description: Enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Black Arrows are Slowed by 15%. Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against Slowed enemy Heroes deal 1% of their maximum Health as damage.

level4.name: Unstable Poison
level4.description: Minions that die under the effects of Shadow Dagger or Sylvanas's Traits explode, dealing 150~~0.04~~ damage to nearby Minions, Mercenaries, and Summons.

level4.name: Mercenary Queen
level4.description:
Friendly non-Elite Mercenaries near Sylvanas deal 60% more damage. 

Sylvanas's Basic Attacks Stun and instantly apply 3 stacks of Black Arrows to neutral Mercenaries.  Sylvanas deals 30% additional damage to Mercenaries with 3 stacks of Black Arrows.

level4.name: Haunting Arrows
level4.description: Black Arrows can now be activated to cause all Basic Attacks and Abilities to Stun Minions and Structures for 3 seconds. Lasts for 10 seconds. Basic Attacks against Structures reduce this cooldown by 3 seconds.

level7.name: Barbed Shot
level7.description: Hitting the same enemy with 5 shots of Withering Fire causes the 5th shot to deal 400% bonus damage.

level7.name: Lost Soul
level7.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes and Structures with 3 stacks of Black Arrows reduce the cooldown of Shadow Dagger by 0.75 seconds, doubled against Heroes.

level7.name: Festering Wounds
level7.description: Increase Haunting Wave's damage by 15%. Haunting Wave applies 3 stacks of Black Arrows.

level10.name: Wailing Arrow
level10.description: Shoot an arrow that can be reactivated to deal 228~~0.04~~ damage and Silence enemies in an area for 2.5 seconds. The arrow detonates automatically if it reaches maximum range.

level10.name: Mind Control
level10.description: After 0.25 seconds, fire a missile that Mind Controls the first enemy Hero hit. Heroes hit are Silenced, Slowed by 30%, have 3 stacks of Black Arrows applied to them, and are forced to walk towards Sylvanas for 1.75 seconds.

level13.name: Cold Embrace
level13.description: Shadow Dagger reduces the Armor of the initial target by 25 and any enemy it spreads to by 10 for 2.5 seconds.

level13.name: Windrunner
level13.description: Haunting Wave can be cast a second time for free within 4 seconds after teleporting. Teleporting with Haunting Wave resets the cooldown of Withering Fire.

level13.name: Remorseless
level13.description:
Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Black Arrows shoot an untalented shot of Withering Fire. This shot of Withering Fire applies Black Arrows.

 Increase Sylvanas's Basic Attack range by 1.

level16.name: Evasive Fire
level16.description: Hitting an enemy with Withering Fire grants 6% Movement Speed for 2 seconds, up to 30%. Basic Attacks refresh this duration.

level16.name: Life Drain
level16.description: Heal for 15% of damage dealt by Sylvanas to enemies with 3 stacks of Black Arrows. Healing is doubled against Heroes.

level16.name: Will of the Forsaken
level16.description: Activate to become Unstoppable and gain 40% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

level20.name: Deafening Blast
level20.description: Enemies at the center of Wailing Arrow's explosion take 50% more damage and are Silenced for twice as long.

level20.name: Dark Lady's Call
level20.description: Heroes hit by Mind Control have their vision radius greatly reduced for 5 seconds. Mind Control's cooldown is reduced by 25 seconds.

level20.name: Withering Barrage
level20.description: Withering Fire applies Black Arrows, and Heroes hit by Withering Fire reduce its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

level20.name: Bolt of the Storm
level20.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.
